title: feat(research): construct one-pass twiddle header producer
body:
## Summary

Construct a direct one-pass producer for the source's physical synthetic-twiddle address order.

```text
physical address bits, once
  retain early low bits in per-axis words
  when branch arrives, add masked word and reuse it for branch
  accumulate remaining masked bits
  emit exact forward/opposite exponent; clear private registers
```

The author-written all-size proof gives data capacity `d*max(a,1)+h+1` bits plus eight Boolean scratch bits, and exact AND/XOR counts. Separately, the earlier extracted low-prefix cut has exactly `2^(d*b)` suffix functions when `1<=b<=h<ell-1`. The twelve-axis ell=8,K=4,h=5 example needs 36 prefix bits, has a six-bit final sum, and uses 42 producer data bits. Shape/control, output storage and Python object overhead are separate.

PR3559 classifies later canonical cuts without implementing a producer. PR3550 interprets a supplied program with address rereads. Those are contextual comparisons, separately pinned in COMPARISONS.json; this contribution's actual proof premises and runtime oracle are retained canonical-main inputs. Credit Nick Petalas/PR3522, Philipp/mightyOil, Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml, Douglas Colkitt and the source's retained transform lineage.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the encoded-address handoff had no direct shape-driven one-pass register producer or exact earlier-prefix count.
  **After:** 704 complete physical fixtures and 218136 addresses agree with both the direct named-bit exponent and pinned circuit. There are 71 exhaustive physical prefix/suffix classifications, 27744 associated addresses, 378 wide checks, 19 malformed-boundary rejections and three real failed-input register-reset checks. Ten optimized CLI fault groups and a valid retry pass.
- Final committed-head registered CPython3.12 replay, direct normal/optimized science, metadata/pins, source-history publication check and Git-free normal/optimized science plus controls pass. Exact source/export before/after hashes and exclusive owned inode-disjoint copy evidence are retained in the session report.

```sh
python3.12 -I -Werror -B research/streaming-twiddle-header/verify.py
TMPDIR=/absolute/private/run python3.12 -I -Werror -B research/streaming-twiddle-header/test_controls.py
TMPDIR=/absolute/private/run python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/streaming-twiddle-header
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/streaming-twiddle-header --check-source-history
```

README supplies export replay commands. Scientific replay needs no foreign Git objects or network. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Adds one research package and its opt-in replay. No selected-frontier or frozen-input changes. Fixed-tape lowering, encoded descriptor parsing, address enumeration, packet/layer join, dirty caller, complete physical invoice, supplier and kappa remain open.
